continuity: Park Tae Seop’s intuition identifies Jin Taekyung as a siege-cannon-level threat capable of cracking even Myeongdong Guild’s defenses, while Park Jihoon continues to underestimate him.
After the Black Hunters’ secret house was burned, Choi Minwoo led an ambush to secure evidence and captured personnel dispatched by Myeongdong Guild; Taekyung acted independently.
Choi Minwoo called Park Jihoon using Manager Kim’s phone after the Peace Guild captured Myeongdong personnel.
Taekyung captured and held Myeongdong Guild Team 1’s leader in Park Jihoon’s office, then defeated approximately fifty additional Myeongdong Hunters and made the office forbidden territory.
At chapter’s end, two massive presences approached Taekyung’s position and the office door was blown apart; the chapter does not explicitly identify them.
plot: Park Tae Seop worries that Jin Taekyung is powerful enough to crack Myeongdong Guild, but Park Jihoon dismisses the threat. Choi Minwoo then calls Jihoon using Manager Kim’s phone, revealing that the Peace Guild has captured Myeongdong personnel. Jihoon receives a photograph of Taekyung holding the incapacitated Team 1 Leader in Jihoon’s office, followed by the message “Bring Melona when you come,” and crushes the phone in shock. After burning the Black Hunters’ secret house, Taekyung and Choi split up: Choi leads an ambush to secure evidence while Taekyung acts alone. Taekyung defeats roughly fifty Myeongdong Hunters, occupies Jihoon’s office, and keeps an unpaid Security Team Hunter as his cameraman. At the end of the chapter, two massive presences approach and the office door is blasted apart.
translation_decisions: Render 최민우 as Choi Minwoo and 김 실장 as Manager Kim.
Render 그분 as “that person” without identifying the figure behind the Black Hunter operation.
Render 어른폰 as AdultPhone and retain the footnote explaining the Korean child/adult pun.
Render 공성포 as “siege cannon” in Park Tae Seop’s metaphor.
Render 올 때 메로나 as “Bring Melona when you come,” preserving the threatening joke and its footnote.

active_continuity: Taekyung confronted Park Jihoon by phone while holding the Myeongdong Guild Team 1 Leader captive.
Jihoon responded with a taunting, equivocal acknowledgment when Taekyung accused him of sending the twenty-eight Black Hunters.
Jihoon threatened to end Taekyung and the Peace Guild if Taekyung advanced farther.
Taekyung rejected Jihoon’s proposed settlement and entered the nineteenth floor of Myeongdong Guild headquarters.
Myeongdong Guild’s elite Team 1 armed itself and attacked Taekyung inside the headquarters.
Taekyung defeated and incapacitated numerous Team 1 Hunters in rapid succession.
Taekyung used two daggers to deflect five simultaneous blade attacks.
Taekyung broke an A-rank Hunter’s mana-infused arrow and redirected it through three defensive spells into the shooter’s shoulders.
Taekyung used the Flame Divine Palm against the Team 1 Leader.
Taekyung’s Peak realm and Unaffected by a Hundred Poisons made the Team 1 Leader’s Poison spell ineffective.
Taekyung paralyzed the Team 1 Leader with the poisonous fog and seized him by the nape.
Taekyung demanded directions to Park Jihoon’s office, and ten fingers pointed toward one door.
Lee Minsu is a C-rank Hunter in Myeongdong Guild’s Security Team who witnessed the assault.
Taekyung’s assault occurred in Myeongdong Guild headquarters, transforming the nineteenth-floor office area into a battlefield.
Park Tae Seop recognizes Taekyung as a threat capable of cracking Myeongdong Guild, while Jihoon remains dismissive.
Choi Minwoo led an evidence-gathering ambush after the secret house burned and captured Myeongdong Guild personnel.
Taekyung defeated about fifty additional Myeongdong Hunters and occupied Jihoon’s office.
Two massive presences approached Taekyung’s position as the office door was blasted apart.
